structure TauCeti.IsFredholm {𝕜 : Type u_1} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type u_2} {F : Type u_3} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace 𝕜 F] (T : E →L[𝕜] F) :
Prop

A continuous linear map between normed spaces is a Fredholm operator if its kernel is finite dimensional, its range is closed, and its cokernel is finite dimensional.

Closedness of the range is a genuine hypothesis: over an incomplete space a finite-dimensional cokernel need not force it. It is bundled here following the standard convention (McDuff--Salamon, Appendix A.1).

  • finiteDimensional_ker : FiniteDimensional 𝕜 ↥(↑T).ker

    The kernel of a Fredholm operator is finite dimensional.

  • isClosed_range : IsClosed ↑(↑T).range

    The range of a Fredholm operator is closed.

  • finiteDimensional_coker : FiniteDimensional 𝕜 (F ⧸ (↑T).range)

    The cokernel of a Fredholm operator is finite dimensional.
